listings.name: NewPsych Psychologists
listings.credentials: Clinical Psychologists, Psychiatrists, Couples & Family Therapists
listings.description: NewPsych is one of Newcastle's largest and most established psychology practices, with a diverse team of psychologists, clinical psychologists, psychiatrists, and couples therapists. Over 25 years of service, with a comprehensive EAP offering for corporate clients.

listings.name: Elevated Wellbeing Psychology
listings.credentials: Registered Psychologists, Mental Health Social Workers
listings.description: A warm, welcoming team of Newcastle psychologists and mental health social workers providing evidence-based therapy including EMDR, CBT, ACT, and TF-CBT. Serving Newcastle and the Lake Macquarie region.

listings.name: New Lambton Psychology
listings.description: A highly regarded clinical psychology practice in New Lambton with over 10 years of experience. Specialises in individual therapy, group programs, psychological assessments for children, and clinical supervision. All clinicians are AHPRA-endorsed Clinical Psychologists.

listings.name: Lacuna Clinical Psychology
listings.description: Lacuna Clinical Psychology is a Mayfield-based practice specialising in emotion-focused and trauma-informed therapy. Session fee of $250, with an out-of-pocket cost of $104.75 after Medicare rebate (MHCP). Free street parking available nearby.

listings.name: Oracle Psychology
listings.address: Level 1, Suite 6, 19 Bolton Street, Newcastle NSW 2300
listings.description: Newcastle's dedicated child and adolescent psychology practice, led by Principal Clinical Psychologist Daniel Wendt. Unique combination of Education and Psychology expertise, ideal for children and young people navigating school, behaviour, and mental health challenges.

listings.name: Psychology Centre Newcastle
listings.description: A team of clinical and forensic psychologists delivering specialised care across all ages. Uses a range of evidence-based treatments including ACT, CBT, EMDR and Schema Therapy in a collaborative, client-centred environment.

listings.name: Wildflower Psychology
listings.description: A boutique Newcastle West practice with a warm, collaborative approach to therapy. Particularly experienced in women's mental health, relationships, and life transitions.

listings.name: ELD Psychology
listings.address: Suite 3, Level 1, 744 Hunter Street, Newcastle West NSW 2302
listings.description: ELD Psychology provides evidence-based clinical psychology services to adults across Newcastle, Lake Macquarie, and the Hunter region. Warm and caring approach, listening to your story and working collaboratively to provide strategies to overcome challenges.

listings.name: Esteem Psychology
listings.description: AHPRA-endorsed clinical psychologists offering evidence-based psychological therapy for adults, adolescents, and children. Compassionate and welcoming team with personalised service across a range of psychological concerns.

listings.name: Dyer & Dyer Psychologists
listings.address: 710 Hunter Street, Suite 4, Ground Floor, Newcastle West NSW 2302
listings.description: A professional, well-established practice with experienced Clinical and Registered Psychologists Frances Dunn, Dr Kristine Kafer, and Melinda Miller. Providing evidence-based psychological services to Newcastle for over 25 years.
